data.name: Error.Canceled.Cause
data.value: The operation was canceled.

data.name: Error.Canceled.Action
data.value: Start the operation again if you want to continue.

data.name: Error.InvalidSpec.Cause
data.value: The job description is invalid: {0}

data.name: Error.InvalidSpec.Action
data.value: Check the settings or the profile in use.

data.name: Error.UnsupportedSchemaVersion.Cause
data.value: The profile was created by a newer version (schema {0}).

data.name: Error.UnsupportedSchemaVersion.Action
data.value: Update Bootrix or export the profile again.

data.name: Error.ProfileLocked.Cause
data.value: The option "{0}" is locked in the parent profile.

data.name: Error.ProfileLocked.Action
data.value: Remove the change or ask the profile owner to unlock it.

data.name: Error.ProfileCycle.Cause
data.value: The profiles refer to each other in a loop ({0}).

data.name: Error.ProfileCycle.Action
data.value: Remove one of the "extends" references.

data.name: Error.ProfilePackageCorrupt.Cause
data.value: The profile package is damaged or has been modified: {0}

data.name: Error.ProfilePackageCorrupt.Action
data.value: Download the package from its source again.

data.name: Error.JournalCorrupt.Cause
data.value: The job journal could not be read.

data.name: Error.JournalCorrupt.Action
data.value: Write the drive again.

data.name: Error.DeviceNotFound.Cause
data.value: The drive was not found.

data.name: Error.DeviceNotFound.Action
data.value: Re-insert the device and refresh the list.

data.name: Error.DeviceChanged.Cause
data.value: The drive has changed since it was selected.

data.name: Error.DeviceChanged.Action
data.value: Select the device again and confirm once more.

data.name: Error.DeviceProtected.Cause
data.value: This drive is protected ({0}).

data.name: Error.DeviceProtected.Action
data.value: Choose a different drive.

data.name: Error.DeviceBusy.Cause
data.value: The drive is in use by another program ({0}).

data.name: Error.DeviceBusy.Action
data.value: Close the program or retry with "Force dismount".

data.name: Error.DeviceTooSmall.Cause
data.value: The drive is too small. {0} required, {1} available.

data.name: Error.DeviceTooSmall.Action
data.value: Use a larger drive.

data.name: Error.DeviceWriteProtected.Cause
data.value: The drive is write-protected.

data.name: Error.DeviceWriteProtected.Action
data.value: Check the write-protect switch on the stick or memory card.

data.name: Error.DeviceRemoved.Cause
data.value: The drive was removed while writing.

data.name: Error.DeviceRemoved.Action
data.value: Re-insert the device and resume or write again.

data.name: Error.LayoutRejected.Cause
data.value: Windows did not accept the partition layout.

data.name: Error.LayoutRejected.Action
data.value: Unplug the stick, plug it in again and retry.

data.name: Error.VolumeNotMounted.Cause
data.value: Windows did not mount the new volume in time.

data.name: Error.VolumeNotMounted.Action
data.value: Retry, or temporarily disable your antivirus.

data.name: Error.ImageUnreadable.Cause
data.value: The image could not be read: {0}

data.name: Error.ImageUnreadable.Action
data.value: Check that the file is complete and not in use.

data.name: Error.ImageTruncated.Cause
data.value: The image is incomplete. Expected {0}, found {1}.

data.name: Error.ImageTruncated.Action
data.value: Download the image again.

data.name: Error.ImageUnsupported.Cause
data.value: This image format is not supported: {0}

data.name: Error.ImageUnsupported.Action
data.value: Convert the image to a supported format.

data.name: Error.ImageEncrypted.Cause
data.value: The image is encrypted.

data.name: Error.ImageEncrypted.Action
data.value: Decrypt the image first with the program that created it.

data.name: Error.ImageHashMismatch.Cause
data.value: The checksum of the image does not match.

data.name: Error.ImageHashMismatch.Action
data.value: Download the image again from the original source.

data.name: Error.ImageTooLarge.Cause
data.value: The image ({0}) does not fit on the target ({1}).

data.name: Error.ImageTooLarge.Action
data.value: Choose a larger target or a different file system.

data.name: Error.VerifyMismatch.Cause
data.value: The written data differs from the source (offset {0}).

data.name: Error.VerifyMismatch.Action
data.value: The drive may be faulty. Run a fake-capacity and bad-block test.

data.name: Error.DownloadFailed.Cause
data.value: The download failed: {0}

data.name: Error.DownloadFailed.Action
data.value: Check your internet connection and retry. Partial downloads are resumed.

data.name: Error.DownloadBlocked.Cause
data.value: Microsoft rejects the download (code {0}).

data.name: Error.DownloadBlocked.Action
data.value: Bootrix tries the alternative route. Alternatively download the ISO in a browser and select the file.

data.name: Error.DownloadHashMismatch.Cause
data.value: The checksum of the downloaded file is wrong.

data.name: Error.DownloadHashMismatch.Action
data.value: The file was discarded. Start the download again.

data.name: Error.CatalogUnavailable.Cause
data.value: The catalog is not reachable.

data.name: Error.CatalogUnavailable.Action
data.value: Use the last saved catalog or enter the address manually.

data.name: Error.SignatureInvalid.Cause
data.value: The signature of the catalog data is invalid.

data.name: Error.SignatureInvalid.Action
data.value: The data was not applied. Check your connection or update Bootrix.

data.name: Error.ExternalToolFailed.Cause
data.value: The program "{0}" ended with exit code {1}.

data.name: Error.ExternalToolFailed.Action
data.value: See the log for details.

data.name: Error.ExternalToolUntrusted.Cause
data.value: The program "{0}" is not signed by Microsoft and will not be run.

data.name: Error.ExternalToolUntrusted.Action
data.value: Restore the system files (sfc /scannow).

data.name: Error.InsufficientSpace.Cause
data.value: Not enough free space on {0}. {1} required.

data.name: Error.InsufficientSpace.Action
data.value: Choose a different work folder or free up space.

data.name: Error.ImageMountFailed.Cause
data.value: The image could not be mounted.

data.name: Error.ImageMountFailed.Action
data.value: Restart the computer if an earlier operation was interrupted.

data.name: Error.NoRecorder.Cause
data.value: No disc recorder was found.

data.name: Error.NoRecorder.Action
data.value: Connect a recorder and refresh the list.

data.name: Error.MediaNotSupported.Cause
data.value: The inserted disc cannot be written.

data.name: Error.MediaNotSupported.Action
data.value: Insert a suitable blank disc.

data.name: Error.BurnFailed.Cause
data.value: An error occurred while burning: {0}

data.name: Error.BurnFailed.Action
data.value: Try another disc or a lower speed.

data.name: Error.ReadError.Cause
data.value: Errors occurred while reading the disc (from sector {0}).

data.name: Error.ReadError.Action
data.value: Clean the disc or use a different drive.

data.name: Error.CopyProtected.Cause
data.value: The disc is copy-protected.

data.name: Error.CopyProtected.Action
data.value: Copy-protected media are not copied.

data.name: Error.Unknown.Cause
data.value: An unexpected error occurred.

data.name: Error.Unknown.Action
data.value: Export the diagnostic bundle and send it to support.

data.name: App.Name
data.value: Bootrix

data.name: Workshop.Req.Architecture.Pass
data.value: The processor is 64-bit capable ({0}).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Architecture.Fail
data.value: The processor is not 64-bit capable ({0}). Windows 11 only exists for 64-bit processors (x64 and Arm64).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Architecture.Unknown
data.value: The processor architecture could not be determined.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Cores.Pass
data.value: {0} processor cores (at least 2 required).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Cores.Fail
data.value: Only {0} processor core; Windows 11 requires at least 2 cores.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Cores.Unknown
data.value: The number of processor cores is not known for certain ({0} logical processors).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Clock.Pass
data.value: Clock speed {0:0.0} GHz (at least 1 GHz required).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Clock.Fail
data.value: The clock speed of {0:0.0} GHz is below the required 1 GHz.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Clock.NotChecked
data.value: The processor clock speed was not determined.

data.name: Workshop.Req.CpuModel.Fail
data.value: Judging by its name, the processor "{0}" is probably not among the models Microsoft has approved for Windows 11 (an estimate based on the name).

data.name: Workshop.Req.CpuModel.NotChecked
data.value: The processor was not compared with Microsoft's list of supported processors. Windows 11 usually requires 8th generation Intel Core or newer, and AMD Ryzen 2000 series or newer.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Ram.Pass
data.value: {0:0.#} GB of memory (at least 4 GB required).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Ram.Fail
data.value: Only {0:0.#} GB of memory; Windows 11 requires at least 4 GB.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Ram.Borderline
data.value: Windows can use {0:0.#} GB of memory. Whether 4 GB are installed cannot be told for certain because the firmware reserves a part.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Ram.Unknown
data.value: The amount of memory is unknown.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Storage.Pass
data.value: The largest internal disk has {0:0} GB (at least 64 GB required).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Storage.Fail
data.value: The largest internal disk has only {0:0.#} GB; Windows 11 requires at least 64 GB.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Storage.Borderline
data.value: The largest internal disk has {0:0.#} GB, right at the 64 GB limit; Setup might reject it.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Storage.Unknown
data.value: No internal disk was detected.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Firmware.Pass
data.value: The system boots in UEFI mode.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Firmware.Fail
data.value: The system boots in BIOS mode (legacy/CSM); Windows 11 requires UEFI.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Firmware.Unknown
data.value: The firmware type (BIOS or UEFI) is unknown.

data.name: Workshop.Req.SecureBoot.PassOn
data.value: Secure Boot is supported and turned on.

data.name: Workshop.Req.SecureBoot.PassOff
data.value: Secure Boot is supported but turned off. Support is all Windows 11 requires.

data.name: Workshop.Req.SecureBoot.Fail
data.value: Secure Boot is not available in BIOS mode; Windows 11 requires Secure Boot capable UEFI.

data.name: Workshop.Req.SecureBoot.Unknown
data.value: Whether Secure Boot is supported is unknown (not readable without administrator rights).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Tpm.Pass
data.value: TPM {0} is present.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Tpm.FailMissing
data.value: Windows does not find a TPM. Check in the BIOS/UEFI whether a firmware TPM (Intel PTT, AMD fTPM) is turned off.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Tpm.FailVersion
data.value: The TPM is only version {0}; Windows 11 requires TPM 2.0.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Tpm.FailDisabled
data.value: The TPM is disabled in the BIOS/UEFI. Enabling it meets the requirement.

data.name: Workshop.Req.Tpm.Unknown
data.value: The TPM state is unknown (not fully readable without administrator rights).

data.name: Workshop.Req.Graphics.NotChecked
data.value: DirectX 12 support and a WDDM 2.0 driver were not checked.

data.name: Workshop.Data.Nothing
data.value: There is no usable hardware data.

data.name: Workshop.Data.Incomplete
data.value: Some sources could not be read ({0}); the affected results are marked as unknown.

data.name: Workshop.Data.NotElevated
data.value: Bootrix runs without administrator rights. TPM state, BitLocker and Secure Boot can only partly be determined that way. Run the analysis as administrator for a complete result.

data.name: Workshop.Cpu.NoModernInstructions
data.value: The processor lacks {0}. According to community reports Windows 11 from version 24H2 does not start on such processors (not confirmed by Microsoft); bypassing the Setup checks does not change that. Windows 10 22H2 with extended security updates, or Linux, is therefore recommended.

data.name: Workshop.Cpu.Arm64
data.value: Arm64 device: the image must be for Arm64. Drivers for Wi-Fi, storage and touch usually come only from the device maker, and x64 tools only run through emulation.

data.name: Workshop.Cpu.Arm32
data.value: This device has a 32-bit Arm processor; there is no Windows installation media for it.

data.name: Workshop.Cpu.Only32Bit
data.value: The processor can only run 32-bit code. Windows 11 is not possible; Windows 10 22H2 (x86) is the last Windows version for it.

data.name: Workshop.Cpu.Running32Bit
data.value: A 32-bit Windows is running on this 64-bit capable processor. An x64 image is recommended for the reinstallation.

data.name: Workshop.Cpu.NewPlatform
data.value: The processor "{0}" probably belongs to the new Arm platform that Microsoft scoped Windows 11 26H1 to. Older versions may not include the platform support (a hint, not confirmed); if in doubt, use the image from the device maker.

data.name: Workshop.Boot.SecureBootSignedOnly
data.value: Secure Boot is on: only media whose boot manager the firmware accepts will start. FAT32 with Microsoft's original boot manager is recommended instead of NTFS with an additional boot loader.

data.name: Workshop.Boot.Certificate2023
data.value: The firmware has revoked the Windows Production PCA 2011: only boot managers signed with the Windows UEFI CA 2023 start. The medium must contain such a boot manager.

data.name: Workshop.Boot.Certificate2011
data.value: The firmware does not know the Windows UEFI CA 2023 yet: only a boot manager with the previous signature (Windows Production PCA 2011) starts.

data.name: Workshop.Boot.BiosMode
data.value: The system boots in BIOS mode: the medium gets an MBR partition table.

data.name: Workshop.Boot.BiosLargeDisk
data.value: In BIOS mode with MBR only 2 TB of a disk can be used; "{0}" is larger. Large disks need UEFI with GPT.

data.name: Workshop.Licensing.EditionFromFirmware
data.value: The license key in the firmware belongs to the edition "{0}". Windows Setup selects that edition by itself with the key.

data.name: Workshop.Licensing.EditionFromRunning
data.value: The edition of the running Windows ("{0}") is suggested; no firmware key confirms it.

data.name: Workshop.Licensing.EditionUnknown
data.value: The device has a license key in the firmware, but its edition could not be determined unambiguously.

data.name: Workshop.Licensing.NoFirmwareKey
data.value: No license key found in the firmware. The running Windows can still have a digital license.

data.name: Workshop.BitLocker.Active
data.value: BitLocker is active or suspended on {0}. Back up the recovery key before reinstalling; it is requested after changes to firmware or boot order.

data.name: Workshop.BitLocker.Locked
data.value: Drive {0} is locked by BitLocker. Without the recovery key the data cannot be read.

data.name: Workshop.BitLocker.Unknown
data.value: The BitLocker status is unknown (administrator rights needed).

data.name: Workshop.Machine.Virtual
data.value: This is a virtual machine ({0}). TPM, Secure Boot and firmware mode depend on how the VM is configured.

data.name: Workshop.Machine.HyperVGeneration1
data.value: Hyper-V generation 1 VM (BIOS): Windows 11 is meant for a generation 2 VM with UEFI and a virtual TPM.

data.name: Workshop.Machine.ServerHardware
data.value: The device is server hardware. RAID and network drivers come from the server maker; have its driver pack ready. Vendors usually do not certify server hardware for Windows 11.

data.name: Workshop.Machine.RunningServer
data.value: A Windows Server is currently running on the device.

data.name: Workshop.Storage.NoDisk
data.value: No internal disk was detected. In Windows PE a storage driver may be missing.

data.name: Workshop.Lifecycle.RunningVersionEnding
data.value: {0} end of servicing: {1:d} (Home and Pro).

data.name: Workshop.Windows10.EndOfSupport
data.value: Windows 10 22H2 has had no regular support since 14 October 2025. According to Microsoft, extended security updates (ESU) for consumers run until 12 October 2027 and require enrollment; terms may vary by region.

data.name: Workshop.Alternative.Windows10
data.value: Alternative with Microsoft support: Windows 10 22H2 with extended security updates (ESU).

data.name: Workshop.Alternative.Linux
data.value: Alternative: a current Linux distribution; it also runs on older hardware and is updated continuously.

data.name: Workshop.Bypass.Unsupported
data.value: A Windows 11 with bypassed Setup checks is not supported by Microsoft; updates are not guaranteed.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.IntelVmd
data.value: Intel Volume Management Device "{0}" ({1}): without the Intel RST/VMD driver (iaStorVD), Windows Setup may find no drives. Add the driver to the Setup medium.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.IntelRstRaid
data.value: The storage controller "{0}" ({1}) runs in RAID mode (Intel RST). Without the Intel RST driver Windows Setup may find no drives. Add the driver, or switch the BIOS to AHCI before a reinstallation (an existing installation will no longer start afterwards).

data.name: Workshop.Driver.AmdRaid
data.value: The storage controller "{0}" ({1}) runs in AMD RAID mode. Without the AMD RAID driver Windows Setup may find no drives.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.HardwareRaid
data.value: RAID controller "{0}" ({1}): have the manufacturer's driver ready; Windows does not include one for every controller.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.VirtualStorage
data.value: Virtual storage controller "{0}" ({1}): Windows includes no driver for it. Load it in Setup (virtio-win or the VMware driver) or choose another controller type.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.NetworkNoDriver
data.value: No working driver is installed for the network adapter "{0}" ({1}) at the moment (error code {2}). Provide the driver for the reinstallation.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.NetworkVendor
data.value: The network adapter "{0}" ({1}) uses a driver from {2} that is not part of Windows. It may be missing in Setup or the first-run experience; back up the drivers of this PC.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.NetworkVirtual
data.value: Virtual network adapter "{0}" ({1}): Windows includes no driver for it (virtio-win or VMware Tools).

data.name: Workshop.Driver.WirelessNoDriver
data.value: No working driver is installed for the Wi-Fi adapter "{0}" ({1}) at the moment (error code {2}). Provide the driver for the reinstallation.

data.name: Workshop.Driver.WirelessVendor
data.value: The Wi-Fi adapter "{0}" ({1}) uses a driver from {2} that is not part of Windows. It may be missing in Setup or the first-run experience; back up the drivers of this PC.

data.name: Workshop.Capture.SecretsIncluded
data.value: The capture contains secrets in clear text (keys and passwords). Store it encrypted only, and do not print or log it.

data.name: Workshop.Capture.WlanExportFiles
data.value: The exported Wi-Fi profiles in "{0}" contain the keys in clear text. Delete the files as soon as they have been taken over.

data.name: Workshop.Capture.WlanKeysProtected
data.value: For {0} Wi-Fi profiles the key could not be read in clear text (administrator rights needed).

data.name: Workshop.Capture.ProductKeyMayBeGeneric
data.value: The Windows key read from the registry can be a generic installation key when the license is digital; it is then not usable on other hardware.

data.name: Workshop.Capture.RecoveryKeyUnavailable
data.value: No recovery password could be read for {0} (drive locked, no password protector or missing rights).
